title: The default production codexAuthCheck fn's own two branches (auth.json present …
body: The default production codexAuthCheck fn's own two branches (auth.json present vs absent under a controlled HOME) are not directly asserted: the tmpdir test exercises the existsSync primitive, and the codexAuthCheck test only asserts result shape (cannot safely mutate HOME in a parallel runner). Reasonable documented compromise; the decision fn is thoroughly covered via injected checks. Consider a HOME-injectable seam for the default check if fuller coverage is wanted.
